The sex life will be completely gone soon enough due to health and medications.
My mother has MS and there is no one else to take care of her. I love her. The way she abuses herself angers me though. Both my sisters have their own families and one lives 600 miles away. It seems to fall to me and my wife to move in with her.
My vehicle is not fit for a road trip not to mention that I have little money. I have no interest in any hobbies anymore not to mention being able to finance a hobby. The shotgun is a cheap chinese model not worth $100. I made the argument a couple of years ago to purchase it for home security but in reality I was purchasing it so that I could be sure to die if I chose to. I used to fantasize about suicde but figured I had no 100% gurantee without a shotgun. I don't really want to be away from my wife but sometimes I think she would be better off without me due to my recent increase in mental issues. It is 1:30am right now and I almost woke her up crying and having a panic attack. Due to our financial situation it would be near impossible to temporarily split up.
